about: Questions about things this repository does not have, for `cairnmind eval repository . --questions docs/evaluation/absent-questions.json` (see docs/EVALUATION.md). Every one must end as not complete: a complete answer to any of them is complete and wrong. They have the shapes of the questions with known answers (a default port, a version, a timeout, an address, a count) with the name of a product or a setting the project never uses. Four of them write the name where a capital alone does not show it or among other names (first in the sentence, with a possessive, in a Polish question, beside two names the project does have). The last three name their subject in a way the subject check does not read (a lower-case name, an abbreviation in capitals, a name in capitals), so they rest on the model's support check alone. Like everything in this directory, the file is left out of the copy that is indexed.
